description: This file defines a Flutter widget named ShoppingBag, representing a shopping bag icon with an optional item count badge. It uses external assets and themes and is intended for use in a shopping cart interface.

classes.name: ShoppingBag
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a shopping bag icon, optionally with a badge indicating the number of items.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the shopping bag icon, including the SVG icon and the optional item count badge.
